not changed. The iconic menu, topped with the cheeky sentence “We don’t guarantee quality as my wife kills rodents and keeps roaches and rats away,” has been updated with some more fresh dishes and flavors: smoked brisket, chicken almendrado, carnitas, lengua and an arepa ($5.49 according to appetite). Similar to the sit-down location, Taco Tuesdays are massive here. Weekdays from 4pm to 8pm, tacos are $1.25 each.
Tito's Tacos is situated at 805 West Manchester Blvd, Inglewood, CA 90301. For more information visit https://tittos.com/, or call (310) 675-4219.
